verdict.rationale: Trivy is a locally run security scanner for images, filesystems, repos and IaC. It holds no production data of its own and has no hosted environment, so a vendor-provided sandbox or test mode is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Trivy shipping a sandbox environment, so the exception does not apply. Pointing Trivy at a non-production cluster or image would be a user-side arrangement, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
